title: Before we plan the night bus timetable
ask: Answer the question on the last bus before the timetable can be planned.

product.none: No plan yet. These answers decide what the timetable plan covers.

items.title: Does the last night bus wait for the late train?
items.why: The late train runs ten minutes behind on most Fridays.

options.label: Yes, up to ten minutes
options.detail: Riders off the train make the bus, and the route ends later.

options.label: No, it leaves on time
options.detail: The route keeps its times, and some riders wait for a taxi.
